thesis: A toy moving-average crossover may beat an offline comparator on the bundled sample.
null_hypothesis: The toy moving-average crossover has no edge after costs, slippage, and one-bar execution delay.
time_horizon: daily bars over a tiny educational sample
signal_definition: Moving-average crossover on toy OHLCV bars.
expected_failure_modes: failure to beat the offline comparator

acceptance_thresholds.walk_forward: majority of folds beat the comparator on the same offline bars
acceptance_thresholds.parameter_sensitivity: nearby parameter cells show broad non-negative evidence
acceptance_thresholds.cost_grid: returns remain positive across at least half of cost grid cells

data_requirements: rows sorted by date then symbol
posthoc_edit_policy: Do not change the hypothesis or thresholds after observing results.
